source_ready_cases.name: SpankChain
limitations: Detailed LLM result unavailable in final20; historical completion is not reconstructed as a result.

source_ready_cases.name: BurgerSwap
source_ready_cases.missed_reason: Known root cause is cross-function reentrancy invalidating precomputed swap amounts before _swap reuses them. The related reentrancy-events finding reports calls followed by SwapToken emission and does not establish stale-amount/reserve-state reuse. It is not a corresponding ground-truth detection.

source_ready_cases.name: Visor Finance
source_ready_cases.missed_reason: Caller-controlled from contract supplies owner/delegatedTransferERC20 behavior; deposit does not verify receipt before mint. Reported arbitrary-send-erc20 sink is the ELSE/non-contract safeTransferFrom branch, not this documented path.

source_ready_cases.name: Eleven Finance
source_ready_cases.missed_reason: Documented emergencyBurn transfers underlying assets without burning caller vault shares, unlike withdraw. No supplied Slither finding identifies that missing burn or equivalent accounting inconsistency; all 58 findings remain unlabeled additional findings.

source_ready_cases.name: bEarn
source_ready_cases.missed_reason: Documented withdrawal accounting uses inconsistent asset denominations: BvaultsBank treats the amount as BUSD while BvaultsStrategy interprets it as ibBUSD. The supplied Slither warnings do not identify this cross-contract denomination mismatch.

source_ready_cases.name: Spartan Protocol
source_ready_cases.missed_reason: Documented liquidity-share calculation relies on externally manipulable current pool token balances before LP burning, yielding excessive underlying withdrawals. Supplied Slither findings do not identify this share-calculation/spot-balance flaw. Unrelated reentrancy, transfer and return-value warnings are not corresponding detections.
